concerns.redness: One reviewer reports a spot became inflamed after she applied a patch to a pimple that was likely too developed, though she found the patches worked well overall.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer notes these act more like a sticker than a true hydrocolloid bandage, forming a barrier over the blemish but rarely puffing up or turning white the way absorbent patches typically do, making them a weaker choice for anyone who breaks out frequently or severely.
concerns.blemishes: Reports on effectiveness vary widely: several reviewers say blemishes clear or flatten overnight to within a day or two, and one suggests patches work best on an already-opened whitehead rather than a closed pimple; others, however, report no visible difference after use, one taking about a week to see any result where other brands worked in a couple of days, and one reviewer notes the patches form a thinner adhesive barrier rather than a true absorbent hydrocolloid, making them better suited to small, occasional blemishes than large or frequent ones.

aspects.libelle: Sticky residue left behind on removal
Disappointing single-use packaging despite character branding
Too bold or cute for some adults to wear out
Multiple patch sizes for different blemish sizes

extraits.texte: I love squshmallows so I was very excited to get this. They stick great to your skin without irritation, but it didn't do much for my pimples. It would take about a week before I saw any results. I've used other patches and seen results in a couple days. Cute, but not for me.
I love squishmallows so I thought these would work on my acne prone skin. I tried to use one but when I went to take it off I was met with a sticky residue on my face and I saw no difference.
I love squishmallows and I bought these. They work well but they almost melt off my face and leave a sticky residue when you take them off.

I love Squishes, so naturally I got these patches. I purchased the bats ( Emily and Zumeriz ) and the cows ( Patty and Ronnie). They are really cute obviously, and stick very very well they can easily last a whole day if not two. I did deduct a star for the thickness though. They are less hydrocolic patch and more sticker. So they do form a barrier - but don't puff up and turn white except for the tiniest bit. It's not a lack of oil, but a lack of bandage if that makes sense. I only break out occasionally, so these are more of a collectors item that I get to wear sometime so the tradeoff is worth it to me. If you break out alot and want these to heal large or frequent acne spots I would get something else.

They worked great. I have acne prone skin and tried them. I had a smell reaction because I placed one on what was probably a zit that was too developed and it became inflamed. otherwise, fantastic. I use them on small spots on my face and arms.

extraits.titre: I loved this product, but I wish they weren't so BOLD at 37
extraits.texte: These worked extremely well. They had niacinamide, which I badly needed at the time, and they were very effective against the breakout I was having. Plus, the larger patch where Patty & Ronnie are hugging was great for BIG zits and clusters. However, I knocked a point off for an inability to wear them outside, because my breakout was big, and I'm 37 years old. I can't.

Not only are they super cute but very effective. I have tried so many pimple patches and either they don't stick or they don't do anything to the pimple but these are wonderful and they work so well I'm thinking maybe some of the negative comments are because the pimples aren't open that they're applying them too can't place them on a closed zit and expected to do anything. They're usually has to be a whitehead for any pimple patch to work the best. Anyway, highly recommend.

reserve: With only 14 of 15 reviews available, and several reporting the patches did little for their blemishes, this is too small a sample to know how reliably the product works beyond the character-collectible appeal most reviewers focus on.
